# Introduction

This playbook grew from an initial internal guide developed with CSCCE and was refined through four cohorts of the rOpenSci Champions Program.

It captures what we’ve learned about running the program end to end: from recruiting and onboarding Champions, mentors and instructors, to training, evaluation, infrastructure, community building, administration, communication and evaluation. 

It’s designed to help the rOpenSci team run and evolve the program, but we’re sharing it openly in the hope that other organizations and communities running similar programs can adapt and build on it. 

Everything is open and reusable—if you use it, adapt it, or learn something from it, we’d love to hear about it!
